card.description: Survey answers about lunch menu items for the LunchLine app. Each answer says whether a student would buy that item. Paper surveys were handed out to students waiting in the lunch line on one Tuesday.

context.potentialUses: Predict which menu items students would buy, so the school can decide which items to keep and what to recommend.

fields.description: An ID for each row of data.
Whether the student eats meat or is vegetarian.
The menu item the student rated.
Whether the student would buy this item (Yes or No).
